top_stories.title: New Jersey says state police will replace federal agents outside ICE facility | New Jersey | The Guardian
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Governor Mikie Sherrill** and **Attorney General Jennifer Davenport** of New Jersey announced that the state police will be taking over policing functions from federal immigration officers at the Delaney Hall facility, establishing a "peaceful protected zone" for protesters. This move comes amid escalating clashes between protesters and ICE officials, who have been pepper-spraying, tasering, and shoving demonstrators outside the detention center. The governor's office did not immediately respond to questions regarding the state police's plan to arrest protesters leaving the protected zone or whether it violates the state's "sanctuary" policy. **Department of Homeland Security (DHS)** officials confirmed an influx of agents, including those from **Homeland Security Investigations (HSI)**, are arriving to defend the facility and investigate protesters for alleged assaults against ICE officials. The detention center, run by the private prison company GEO Group, has faced accusations of inhumane conditions.

top_stories.title: Ex-US Attorney General Pam Bondi testifies in Epstein files probe | Government News | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Pam Bondi**, former **United States Attorney General**, testified before a closed-door congressional hearing regarding the release of documents tied to the Jeffrey Epstein investigation.  Bondi defended the Justice Department's approach, stating that nearly three million pages of records were released during her tenure and that any withheld documents were properly vetted under the Epstein Files Transparency Act. Critics argue that key documents remain undisclosed or unlawfully redacted, and that the Trump administration has failed to comply with the law. The House Oversight Committee continues its investigation into the matter, including interviews with other individuals who had ties to Epstein.

top_stories.title: Trump says he has ‘no interest’ in Kennedy Center after judge orders his name removed from memorial – live | Trump administration | The Guardian
top_stories.rephrased_article: President Trump announced he is meeting in the White House Situation Room to make a final determination on a potential peace deal with Iran.  The president's post on Truth Social hinted at terms of the agreement, including Iran agreeing not to have nuclear weapons or bombs, opening the Strait of Hormuz immediately without tolls, detonating all remaining water mines, and the US taking over "nuclear dust" or enriched uranium buried under Iran’s collapsed nuclear complexes.  The president's post came after he announced a meeting in the Situation Room to make a final determination on the deal. The U.S. Travel Association warned that removing Customs and Border Protection officers from Newark Liberty International Airport could cause economic harm, costing $8 billion in annual international visitor spending and risking nearly 50,000 American jobs. Louisiana lawmakers passed a new congressional map eliminating a majority-Black district, which has been dismantled to give Republicans an advantage in the upcoming midterm elections.

top_stories.title: Canada sidelined in USMCA renegotiations as domestic economy dips | International Trade News | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Canada** was excluded from USMCA renegotiations in Mexico City, as the United States seeks to increase regional content requirements for vehicle manufacturing. **Jamieson Greer**, U.S. Trade Representative, will present a take-it-or-leave-it proposition to **Mexico**. The move comes amid growing trade tensions between the two countries and Canada's economic downturn.  **Canada** is seeking to diversify its trading relationships with countries like China as it seeks to reduce reliance on the United States.

top_stories.title: Jeffrey Donaldson’s letter to alleged victim had ‘nothing to do’ with abuse claims, trial hears | UK news | The Guardian
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Jeffrey Donaldson**, 63, a former MP and leader of the **Democratic Unionist party**, is facing 18 charges of sexual assault, including rape, spanning from 1985 to 2008.  His lawyer stated that a letter written in 2020 apologizing for past behavior was not related to the allegations against him. The complainant, known as Witness A, testified that she believes the letter reflects Donaldson's guilt and shame, while his defense team challenged her account of alleged sexual abuse.  The trial continues with **Eleanor Donaldson**, his wife, facing a separate trial of the facts for aiding and abetting rape and indecent assault.

top_stories.title: The shrinkage of Pakistan’s aid chart - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
top_stories.rephrased_article: Pakistan's health system is facing severe challenges due to reduced overseas development assistance (ODA).  **USAID**, **The Global Fund**, and other donors have cut funding for programs like TB, HIV/AIDS, maternal and child health, family planning, and immunization. This has led to program closures, staff layoffs, stock shortages, increased out-of-pocket costs for patients, and a rise in disease outbreaks.  **Pakistan's Ministry of National Health Services**, **Global Fund**, and other organizations are struggling to address the crisis. The government needs to take ownership of the health system and develop sustainable funding mechanisms to ensure long-term resilience.

top_stories.title: Polish president threatens to strip Ukraine’s Zelenskyy of top state honour | The World Wars News | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Polish** President Karol Nawrocki has proposed stripping **Ukrainian** President Volodymyr Zelenskyy of Poland's top honor, the Order of the White Eagle, following a decree renaming a military unit after Ukrainian nationalist fighters who killed Poles during World War II.  **Nawrocki** expressed outrage over the move and called for a meeting of the Chapter of the Order of the White Eagle to discuss the withdrawal of the award. **Tusk**, the Polish Prime Minister, also condemned the decision, stating it "wounds our historical sensitivity." **Walesa**, a Nobel Peace Prize-winner and key figure in Poland's fall from communism, has stopped wearing a Ukrainian flag pin as a result of Zelenskyy's actions.

top_stories.title: Nato chief vows 'absolute solidarity' with Romania after Russian drone crash injures 2 - World - DAWN.COM
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Nato** chief Mark Rutte assured **Romania’s** president of the alliance's solidarity after a Russian drone attack injured two people in Galati. The incident, the first time a drone hit a densely populated area in Romania during the war, is likely to increase tensions on the eastern flank of **NATO**.  The Romanian authorities condemned Russia's reckless behavior and requested measures to accelerate the transfer of anti-drone capabilities to Romania. **Ursula von der Leyen**, European Commission head, called it a violation of international law.

top_stories.title: Could Alberta trigger Canada’s Brexit moment? | News | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Alberta** separatists are gaining momentum, with hundreds of thousands signing a petition demanding a vote on independence. **Prime Minister Mark Carney** warns this could become Canada's Brexit moment, as the movement is now headed toward a government-backed referendum.  The potential for secession in **Alberta**, if successful, would be unprecedented in Canadian history.

top_stories.title: Pregnant woman with 4-year-old son forced to sign deportation papers after being held at US airport for days - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: A pregnant Ghanaian woman, **Annabella Gyasi**, and her four-year-old son have been detained at Washington Dulles International Airport for over a week due to immigration concerns.  **Gyasi** travelled from Ghana for a medical appointment in Ohio but was detained by US Customs and Border Protection officials after claiming fear of persecution in Ghana. Her lawyers allege that **Gyasi** has experienced pregnancy-related complications, including vaginal bleeding and light-headedness, while being held in a windowless detention room.  The ACLU argues that **Gyasi** signed deportation paperwork out of desperation due to the lack of adequate food for both mother and child. The Department of Homeland Security denies allegations of mistreatment, stating all detainees have access to necessary medical care.
